01

About

From 2024 to 2026, I was a postdoctoral fellow at the Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research (BICMR), Peking University. I received my Ph.D. in Mathematics from the Southern University of Science and Technology in 2024 under the supervision of Prof. Raúl Ures, and I was a visiting research scholar at Penn State University.

My research is in dynamical systems and ergodic theory, with a particular focus on partially hyperbolic dynamics, accessibility, ergodicity, and the topology of 3-manifolds. I am interested in how geometric and topological structures govern the long-term behavior of smooth dynamical systems.

Research

Partial hyperbolicity

Accessibility, center dynamics, and classification problems for partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms.

accessibility · center foliations · 3-manifolds

Ergodic theory

Mechanisms that connect accessibility, transitivity, and ergodicity in conservative dynamics.

ergodicity · transitivity · conservative systems

Geometric dynamics

Interactions among topology, invariant foliations, Anosov flows, and smooth dynamical systems.

Anosov flows · foliations · topology
